messages:
anya: quick q — hovercard on Cost dashboard shows cache savings ≠ per-route card for same time window. Anyone else?

sam: yep saw it earlier today. hovercard shows bigger savings. think hovercard uses amortized credits.

miguel: can we get a repro? post a route id and timeframe and I can pull traces.

olivia: DM'd @anya route=org:acme/service:search window=2026-02-13T15:00..16:00Z — hovercard shows -$12.34 cache, route card shows -$4.56.

sam: my hunch: hovercard aggregates sessionized prefetch refunds across split routes, route card shows per-invocation raw token delta. probably different attribution.

anya: here's a quick snippet I used to compare (very rough):

```sql
SELECT route, sum(token_cost) as raw_cost, sum(amortized_cache_credit) as amortized_credit
FROM billing_events
WHERE time >= '2026-02-13T15:00:00Z' AND time < '2026-02-13T16:00:00Z'
GROUP BY route;
```

miguel: ok that helps. looks like amortized_credit is being applied at session level before route demux. when routes split we end up attributing full credit to one branch in hovercard UI.

olivia: customer blocked — they expect per-route totals to match hovercard drilldown. UX: could show "(amortized)" badge and a toggle to switch to raw view.

sam: implementation idea: feature flag `hovercard_cost_mode = "amortized" | "raw"`; backend should expose both numbers, UI picks which to show. default to amortized to match current behavior.

miguel: backend caveat — storing both numbers increases payload size for hovercards. cheap fix: compute raw on demand for drilldown, store amortized for list view.

cost-bot: CostService: nightly-recalc job completed 2026-02-14T08:12Z — 43 routes updated (delta>0.01). See /ops/cost-jobs/1721

anya: can someone open a tiny RFC + PR template? include: data contract, perf impact, migration plan, QA steps with sample dataset.

olivia: I'll write the RFC and add a small e2e with the acme repro. assigning to @sam + @miguel for backend.

sam: ok i'll pick up backend PR next week. +1 for toggle.

anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
